verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents sharing specific TOTP codes with teammates through temporary end-to-end encrypted links. That is a one-off link-sharing feature, not shared vaults or collections with per-member access control. No evidence shows team vaults, shared collections, membership management or per-member permissions, so this is adjacent rather than direct support.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control
